notes: Proved together with A129756: A129756.A083219_roots, for x^(n+1) - x^n - ... - 1 the number of roots with Re < 0 is n - 2 floor(n/4). The conjecture is off by one in its indexing (degree n+1, not n); see OEIS/A129756/README.md. Outside Lean: the index-shift reading.
